# Perform basic analyses, output figures and tables for Temperature, Salinity, Dissolved Oxygen data

``` {r BasicStats}
# Temperature
Temp_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Temp_mean = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_min  = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else min(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_max  = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else max(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Salinity
Sal_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Sal_mean = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else mean(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_min  = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else min(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_max  = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else max(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Dissolved Oxygen
DO_pct_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    DO_pct_mean = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else mean(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    DO_pct_min  = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else min(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    DO_pct_max  = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else max(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



```

``` {r WQ figures}

# Temperature
ggplot(Temp_daily %>% filter(StationCode == "Cat Point", year(Date) == ReportYear), 
       aes(x = Date, color = StationCode, fill = StationCode)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Temp_min, ymax = Temp_max),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Temp_mean),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Temperature",
    color = "Station",
    fill = "Station"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

``` {r TempSalDO models}
### Calculate monthly historical means and variability

## Temperature
Temp_monthly <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp),
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Year, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Temp_mean = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate the historical distribution for each station and month, excluding ReportYear. 
# This gives us the typical monthly HISTORICAL conditions
Temp_historical <- Temp_monthly %>%
  filter(Year >= 2002, Year <= ReportYear - 1) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Historical_mean = mean(Temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_sd = sd(Temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_low = quantile(Temp_mean, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_high = quantile(Temp_mean, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Isolate ReportYear value
Temp_current <- Temp_monthly %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  select(StationCode, Month, Temp_current = Temp_mean)

# combine the two tables
Temp_comparison <- Temp_historical %>%
  left_join(Temp_current, by = c("StationCode", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = Temp_current - Historical_mean,
    Anomaly = Difference / Historical_sd
  )

# Salinity Figure
TempFigure <- ggplot(Temp_comparison, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = Historical_low,
      ymax = Historical_high
    ),
    alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Historical_mean),
    linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Temp_current),
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Temp_current),
    size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ StationCode) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    title = "2025 Temperature Compared with Historical Conditions",
    subtitle = "Historical period: 2002–2024; shaded area represents the 10th–90th percentile") +
  
  theme_classic()

## Salinity
Sal_monthly <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp),
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date)
  ) %>%

    .groups = "drop"

# calculate the historical distribution for each station and month, excluding ReportYear. 
# This gives us the typical monthly HISTORICAL conditions
Sal_historical <- Sal_monthly %>%
  filter(Year >= 2002, Year <= ReportYear - 1) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Historical_mean = mean(Sal_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_sd = sd(Sal_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_low = quantile(Sal_mean, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_high = quantile(Sal_mean, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Isolate ReportYear value
Sal_current <- Sal_monthly %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  select(StationCode, Month, Sal_current = Sal_mean)

# combine the two tables
Sal_comparison <- Sal_historical %>%
  left_join(Sal_current, by = c("StationCode", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = Sal_current - Historical_mean,
    Anomaly = Difference / Historical_sd
  )

# Salinity Figure
SalinityFiguer <- ggplot(Sal_comparison, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = Historical_low,

    ),

    title = "2025 Salinity Compared with Historical Conditions",
```
